svg.aria-label: Phase plane of the double-integrator example: the optimal path from (1,0) curls into the origin across the level sets of V; the momentum is drawn as arrows normal to the level sets

rect.style: fill: color-mix(in srgb, #ffffff var(--fig-keep), var(--fig-bg)); stroke: color-mix(in srgb, #e2e8f0 var(--fig-keep), var(--fig-faint))
